scope: Every alternative HW-02 considers for the AI Core matrix:vector balance lives here. integration/detailed/matrix_vector_search.js enumerates the product of the searched dimensions, scores every candidate on the per-kernel hiding bounds and the K3 detailed replay, and writes only the winner to out/detailed/matrix_vector_design.json. The per-option comparison is quoted in the document, section 2.5.
evidence: Vector op counts, TECH.vectorUtil, TECH.unpackParamsPerLaneCycle and the area overheads are ASSUMPTIONs (B-006, O-006, O-012). Areas are the SF4 die areas of k3_physical_basis.resize(A.physical(x)) plus the option overheads.
ratioConvention: BF16 dense matrix peak : vector peak (lanes x 2 ops x f) = MACs : lanes, per die or per core class
hiddenCriterion: per kernel: vector lane-cycles / lanes <= matrix FLOPs / (2 x MACs x matrixUtil x fill)

requirements.modelsReason: the repository serves three models; the K3-only requirement is shown as a variant in the document
requirements.hiddenReason: every H-core kernel (attention, DSA indexer, KDA state) of the required models must hide its vector work under its matrix work. The L-core GEMV unpack at B=1 has a bound of about 3:1 (about 666 lanes per L core); it is reported, not required, and its time is charged in the K3 system replay
requirements.contractReason: the L1 budget contract (integration/detailed/design_contract.js) owns the system requirement: the compute domain answers for B-SERIAL-CMP, and since this space has no computeScale dimension the entry is tested through the target it was derived from (K3 replay TPS/usr >= contract target.tpsPerUser). Holding the replay to the published point instead made the shipped design its own requirement

packageFit.keepOutReason: the observed keep-out of the published point, 658.29 / 5248 (teams/hardware/inputs/physical_design_space.json, reserveFraction option 0.1254: recorded as observed, not chosen). A tighter reserve is an unverified ASSUMPTION there and is deliberately not used here to admit a candidate
packageFit.reason: 8 compute dies at the candidate's die area (shared-port charge included) plus the memory cubes must fit the placement window less the keep-out. The published point leaves 67.17 mm2 (09_PACKAGE_POWER_RAS.md; it left 0.189 mm2 before the shared-port reclaim of ADR-0023), so an option may add at most that room divided by the 8 dies to the die area

vectorOps.evidence: ASSUMPTION (O-006): indexer ReLU + weighted FMA across index heads; threshold/radix top-k select over the scored context; KDA per-channel decay + delta update; KDA matrix FLOPs as k3_operator_sram_sim (7 x B x heads x 128 x 128). Softmax ops per score belong to the expUnit dimension

constraints: every H-core kernel of the required models hides its vector work (kernel bound >= core MACs:lanes)
K3 detailed replay at the published point with only vectorLanes (and, for native input, the unpack) changed reaches the contract target of requirements.contractEntry
the die, with the shared-port charge and the option overheads, stays within its area and power limits (O.evaluate feasibility, then the die-area limit on the figure that includes both)
8 dies at that area plus the memory cubes fit the placement window less the observed keep-out (requirements.packageFit)
objective: least die area including the option overheads

vectorLanes.question: Vector lanes per core (the model has one vectorLanes for L and H cores)

lowPrecisionInput.question: Where FP8/MXFP4 weights, FP8 KV and FP8 index keys are turned into tensor operands

vectorUnpack.evidence: P1 published point: BF16-only tensor engines; every sub-BF16 operand is dequantized on the vector lanes at TECH.unpackParamsPerLaneCycle

nativeTensor.evidence: ASSUMPTION (O-012): the tensor engines accept FP8 E4M3 and MXFP4 with block scales directly, so no dequant runs on the vector lanes; the multi-format MAC array costs 8% of the matrix area (multi-precision MAC designs are commonly quoted at 5-15% over a single-format MAC; knowledge, not evidence for this array). The document reports the break-even overhead

expUnit.question: How the softmax exp is computed on the vector lanes

sfu.evidence: ASSUMPTION (O-006): an exp/reciprocal special-function unit shared by the lanes; softmax costs max, sub, exp, sum, rescale = 8 ops per score (k3_operator_sram_sim: 8 x B x nh x len); the SFU costs 10% of the vector area (TECH.vectorLaneArea is taken as ALU only)

polynomial.evidence: ASSUMPTION (O-006): exp as a range reduction plus polynomial on the ALU lanes, 18 ops per score; no SFU area

lanesPerCoreClass.chosen: one lane count for L and H cores
alternatives: separate L and H lane counts
lanesPerCoreClass.reason: A.physical() and mappedPlan() have a single vectorLanes, so a per-class split cannot be replayed on the detailed model yet. L cores need about 4:1 for B=1 GEMV unpack and H cores 44-100:1, so a split would save area; revisit after the model is extended

tmaDecode.chosen: decode in the tensor engine or on the vector lanes
alternatives: decoder in the TMA shared-to-local path
tmaDecode.reason: not modeled: decoding in TMA writes BF16 into local SRAM, 2-4x the bytes of FP8/MXFP4, and the TMA/local write-port model (O-007) does not charge it yet

batch.reason: the published point is B=1 decode; the GEMV bounds for B up to 16 are reported as sensitivity
